highlights.title: Agents keep going when a message is flagged
highlights.line: When Claude's safety check flags a message, an agent on Opus 5.5 switches to Opus 4.8 and keeps going. On Windows, new agents only.

highlights.title: The Guide says when it is out of usage
highlights.line: When the Guide's Claude account hits its usage limit, the Guide now says so and keeps helping on Kosmos's backup, instead of going quiet.

highlights.title: See a file full page
highlights.line: Click a file attached to a message to see it full page, with a button to show it on your computer, or to download it over Kosmos+.

highlights.title: Room posts are not sent twice
highlights.line: An agent's room post that got through is no longer reported back to it as failed, so teammates stop getting it twice.
